name: Lakera
summary: Lakera is an AI security company whose runtime product screens prompts and model outputs for prompt injection, data leakage and other attacks, alongside a red-teaming product. Check Point announced its acquisition in September 2025 and now sells the products under Check Point names.
facts: Lakera (Zurich and San Francisco), part of Check Point
Check Point AI Agent Security (runtime, formerly Lakera Guard), AI Red Teaming (formerly Lakera Red)
Hosted API; free sign-up at platform.lakera.ai
goodFor: Screening user input and tool output for prompt injection
Teams already buying from Check Point
watchOut: Product naming is mid-transition after the acquisition
